\"description\": \"Provides archival lifecycle management with configurable retention, restoration, audit\\ntracking, and compliance metadata. Archivable manages the full archive-restore-purge\\nlifecycle, including soft-delete with configurable duration before hard deletion,\\npartial restoration support, and per-archive compliance tagging.\\n\\nObjects composing Archivable can be soft-deleted (moved to an \\\"archived\\\" state with\\nfull data retention), restored within a configurable window, or permanently purged\\nafter the retention period expires. The trait tracks who archived the entity, why,\\nand through what method (manual, automated, policy) for audit trail completeness.\",\n+      \"category\": \"lifecycle\",\n+      \"tags\": [\n+        \"lifecycle\",\n+        \"archival\",\n+        \"retention\",\n+        \"compliance\",\n+        \"audit\",\n+        \"soft-delete\"\n+      ],\n+      \"contexts\": [\n+        \"card\",\n+ \"position\": null,\n+          \"priority\": null,\n+          \"props\": {\n+            \"archivedAtField\": \"archived_at\",\n+            \"restoredAtField\": \"restored_at\",\n+ \"restoration_metadata\"\n+          }\n+        },\n+        {\n+          \"component\": \"ArchivePill\",\n+          \"context\": \"card\",\n+          \"position\": \"before\",\n+ [\n+        {\n+          \"name\": \"gracePeriodDays\",\n+          \"type\": \"number\",\n+          \"required\": false,\n+          \"description\": \"Number of days after archival before {\n+          \"name\": \"retainHistory\",\n+          \"type\": \"boolean\",\n+          \"required\": false,\n+          \"description\": \"Whether archival retains a readable change history that \"description\": \"Maximum number of days archived entities can be restored when history is retained.\\nAfter this window, restoration is no longer possible even if the entity hasn't been\\nhard-deleted yet.\\n\",\n+          \"validation\": {\n+            \"minimum\": 0,\n+            \"maximum\": 365\n+          }\n+        },\n+        {\n+          \"name\": \"softDeleteDuration\",\n+          \"type\": \"number\",\n+          \"required\": false,\n+          \"description\": \"Days the entity remains in soft-deleted state before automatic hard deletion.\\nDistinct from gracePeriodDays: gracePeriodDays is the notification/warning window,\\nwhile softDeleteDuration is the total retention period. When set, a background\\nprocess purges entities where (archived_at + softDeleteDuration) has passed.\\n\",\n+          \"default\": 90,\n+          \"validation\": {\n+            \"minimum\": 0,\n+            \"maximum\": 3650\n+          }\n+        },\n+        {\n+          \"name\": \"allowPartialRestore\",\n+          \"type\": \"boolean\",\n+          \"required\": false,\n+          \"description\": \"When true, archived entities can be partially restored — selecting which fields\\nor related data to bring back rather than restoring the entire entity. Advanced compliance\\nfeatures (crypto-shredding, KMS integration, tamper-proof hashing) are documented\\nin R21.3 research and targeted for future enrichment.\\n\\nCore concepts:\\n- Audit Log: append-only array of AuditEntry records\\n- Transition Capture: from_state → to_state with timestamp, actor, and reason\\n- Retention Policy: configurable retention period for log entries\\n- Actor Tracking: optional actor_id capture for accountability\\n- Reason Enforcement: optional requirement for transition justification\",\n+      \"category\": \"lifecycle\",\n+      \"tags\": [\n+        \"audit\",\n+        \"compliance\",\n+        \"trail\",\n+        \"lifecycle\",\n+        \"transition\",\n+        \"accountability\"\n+      ],\n+      \"contexts\": [\n+        \"detail\",\n+        \"timeline\"\n+      ],\n+      \"viewExtensions\": [\n+        {\n+          \"component\": \"AuditTimeline\",\n+          \"context\": \"timeline\",\n+          \"position\": \"main\",\n+          \"priority\": 60,\n+          \"props\": {\n+            \"auditLogField\": \"audit_log\",\n+            \"maxVisible\": 7,\n+            \"showFromState\": true,\n+            \"showActorId\": true,\n+            \"showReason\": true\n+          }\n+        },\n+        {\n+          \"component\": \"AuditSummaryCard\",\n+          \"context\": \"detail\",\n+          \"position\": \"main\",\n+          \"priority\": 50,\n+          \"props\": {\n+            \"auditLogField\": \"audit_log\",\n+            \"lastN\": 5,\n+            \"showTransitionCount\": true,\n+            \"showLastTransitionTime\": true,\n+            \"showLastActor\": true\n+          }\n+        }\n+      ],\n+      \"parameters\": [\n+        {\n+          \"name\": \"retentionDays\",\n+          \"type\": \"number\",\n+          \"required\": false,\n+          \"description\": \"Number of days to retain audit log entries before archival eligibility.\\nValue of 0 means indefinite retention. Does not auto-delete — serves as\\na policy signal for downstream archival processes.\\n\",\n+          \"default\": 0,\n+          \"validation\": {\n+            \"minimum\": 0\n+          }\n+        },\n+        {\n+          \"name\": \"requireTransitionReason\",\n+          \"type\": \"boolean\",\n+          \"required\": false,\n+          \"description\": \"When true, every state transition must include a reason string.\\nEnforces accountability by preventing silent status changes.\\n\",\n+          \"default\": false\n+        },\n+        {\n+          \"name\": \"trackActorId\",\n+          \"type\": \"boolean\",\n+          \"required\": false,\n+          \"description\": \"When true, actor_id is captured on each transition.
